record.bible_text: For, behold, in those days<WH03117>, and in that time<WH06256>, when I shall bring again<WH07725><WTH8686><WTH8675><WH07725><WTH8799> the captivity<WH07622> of Judah<WH03063> and Jerusalem<WH03389>,

Because ye have taken<WH03947><WTH8804> my silver<WH03701> and my gold<WH02091>, and have carried<WH0935><WTH8689> into your temples<WH01964> my goodly<WH02896> pleasant things<WH04261>: <RF>pleasant: Heb. desirable<Rf>

The children<WH01121> also of Judah<WH03063> and the children<WH01121> of Jerusalem<WH03389> have ye sold<WH04376><WTH8804> unto the Grecians<WH03125><WH01121>, that ye might remove them far<WH07368><WTH8687> from their border<WH01366>. <RF>the Grecians: Heb. the sons of the Grecians<Rf>

And I will sell<WH04376><WTH8804> your sons<WH01121> and your daughters<WH01323> into the hand<WH03027> of the children<WH01121> of Judah<WH03063>, and they shall sell<WH04376><WTH8804> them to the Sabeans<WH07615>, to a people<WH01471> far off<WH07350>: for the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> .<CM>

Multitudes<WH01995>, multitudes<WH01995> in the valley<WH06010> of decision<WH02742>: for the day<WH03117> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> near<WH07138> in the valley<WH06010> of decision<WH02742>. <RF>decision: or, concision, or, threshing<Rf>

So shall ye know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> dwelling<WH07931><WTH8802> in Zion<WH06726>, my holy<WH06944> mountain<WH02022>: then shall Jerusalem<WH03389> be holy<WH06944>, and there shall no strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> pass through<WH05674><WTH8799> her any more. <RF>holy: Heb. holiness<Rf><CM>
